title: Rubric - Hardcoded Values
evidence: Criteria reference values traceable to input files: criterion 10 references 'the same regular sampling interval used in the corresponding expected file' — bound to the expected file and gameplay_config.txt telemetry_sample_interval_s=1.0. Criterion 30 references 'the time gap between those AUTO events matches the corresponding gap in the expected file, within plus or minus 20 percent' — bound to the expected file and gameplay_config.txt auto_cycle_interval_s=3.0. Visual criteria reference 'consistent with the corresponding expected file' — properly bound to bomb_blast_frame.png. No arbitrary numeric thresholds are hardcoded without source. The 'twelve seconds' in criterion 8 comes directly from the prompt ('covering at least twelve continuous seconds of play'). The 10% and 20% tolerances in criteria 10 and 30 are reasonable engineering tolerances for runtime measurement.
